fields.name: column
fields.description: Column key.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: ascending or descending.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Unique key; also the row field read by default.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Header content.

fields.name: accessor
fields.description: Value used for sorting, filtering and default display. Default: `row[key]`.

fields.name: cell
fields.description: Render the cell. Default: the accessor's value as text.

fields.name: sortable
fields.description: Allow sorting by this column. Default `false`.

fields.name: compare
fields.type: (a: unknown, b: unknown, rowA: Row, rowB: Row) => number
fields.description: Custom sort order (return <0, 0, >0). Default: numbers, dates, then text in the user's locale.

fields.name: searchable
fields.description: Include in the search box. Default `true` for text and numbers.

fields.name: filter
fields.type: (value: unknown, filterValue: unknown, row: Row) => boolean
fields.description: Custom filter for this column's filter value. Default: case- and accent-insensitive "contains".

fields.name: align
fields.description: Text alignment. Numbers default to `end`.

fields.name: width
fields.description: CSS width, e.g. `120` or `'20%'`.

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: Hide the column (it still counts for search).

fields.name: resizable
fields.description: Let people drag (or use arrow keys on) the column's edge to resize it. Also turned on for all columns by DataTable's `resizableColumns`.

fields.name: minWidth
fields.description: Smallest width when resizing, in px. Default 64.

fields.name: pin
fields.description: Keep the column visible while the table scrolls sideways. Pinned columns use their numeric `width` (default 160px).

fields.name: editable
fields.description: Edit cells in place: double-click, Enter or F2 to edit, Enter to save, Escape to cancel. Saves through DataTable's `onCellEdit`.

fields.name: validate
fields.description: Return a message to reject a value while editing, e.g. `(v) => v ? undefined : 'Required'`.

fields.name: editor
fields.type: (props: { value: unknown; row: Row; commit: (value: unknown) => void; cancel: () => void }) => React.ReactNode
fields.description: Custom editor instead of the default text/number input. Call `commit(value)` to save or `cancel()`.

fields.name: aria-label
fields.description: Screen-reader text for headers without visible text (e.g. an actions column).

fields.name: data
fields.description: The rows: an array of objects. Each needs a unique `id`, or pass `getRowKey`.

fields.name: columns
fields.description: What to show, in order. Each column has a `key` (the field to read), a `header`, and options like `sortable`, `width`, `cell`, `editable` or `pin`.

fields.name: getRowKey
fields.description: Stable id for each row. Default: `row.id`, then the index.

fields.name: sort
fields.description: Controlled sort rules (first wins).

fields.name: defaultSort
fields.description: Starting sort, e.g. `[{ column: 'updated', direction: 'descending' }]`. Add more entries to sort by several columns.

fields.name: onSortChange
fields.description: Called with the new sort rules when a header is clicked.

fields.name: search
fields.description: Controlled search text (matches any searchable column).

fields.name: defaultSearch
fields.description: Starting text in the search box.

fields.name: onSearchChange
fields.description: Called with the search text as it's typed. Use it to search on your server.

fields.name: filters
fields.description: Controlled per-column filter values, keyed by column.

fields.name: defaultFilters
fields.description: Starting filter values, by column key.

fields.name: onFiltersChange
fields.description: Called with all filter values whenever one changes. Use it to filter on your server.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Controlled page (0-based).

fields.name: defaultPage
fields.description: Starting page (0-based) when the table manages paging itself.

fields.name: onPageChange
fields.description: Called with the new page index (0-based).

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Rows per page; `0` turns paging off. Default 10.

fields.name: defaultPageSize
fields.description: Starting rows per page. Default 10, or all rows with `virtualize`.

fields.name: onPageSizeChange
fields.description: Called with the new number of rows per page.

fields.name: selectedKeys
fields.description: Controlled selected row keys.

fields.name: defaultSelectedKeys
fields.description: Rows that start selected, by key.

fields.name: onSelectionChange
fields.description: Called with the set of selected row keys, across all pages.

fields.name: manual
fields.description:
Server-side mode: you sort, filter and page the data yourself (e.g. in an
API call) and pass the current page as `data` with the total `rowCount`.

fields.name: rowCount
fields.description: Total rows on the server, for paging in `manual` mode.
